EXODUS CHAPTER 39

The holy garments, Exo 39:1.

The ephod, Exo 39:2-7

The breastplate, with twelve stones therein, Exo 39:8-21.

The robe of the ephod, Exo 39:22-26.

The coats, mitre, and girdle of fine linen, Exo 39:27-29.

The plate of the holy crown, Exo 39:30,31.

All is viewed and approved by Moses, Exo 39:32-43
e: i.e. Both the people for their liberal contribution, and the workmen for their great care and industry.
